definition: An original or certified copy handed over, posted or presented in person.
An unsigned digital file whose authenticity nobody can check, and which is therefore trusted on appearance.
A human contacting the issuing organisation to ask whether a claim is true.
A verifier querying a register directly, which works only where one exists and grants access.
The subject attending in person so a human can inspect a document or their face.
A third party attesting that a copy matches an original, at a fee and a delay.
The subject asserting something with nothing behind it, accepted because checking costs more than the risk.
